description: Chintu the elephant and Mithu the parrot find a magical glowing blanket. Join them for a soothing moonlight lullaby adventure!
learning: Encouraging nighttime routine and calmness through rhythmic Hindi-English storytelling.

scenes.text: अरे! ये चमकती हुई चादर किसकी है?
scenes.image_prompt: 3D render, vertical 9:16, a mysterious glowing silver blanket floating in a night garden, sparkling dust particles, soft bokeh moonlight, cute whimsical style.

scenes.text: Look! It is so soft and cozy!
scenes.image_prompt: 3D render, vertical 9:16, Chintu the orange baby elephant with blue scarf reaching out with his trunk to touch the shimmering silver blanket, starry night background.

scenes.text: धीरे से छुओ, tap, tap, tap!
scenes.image_prompt: 3D render, vertical 9:16, Mithu the tiny green parrot with red cap landing softly on the blanket, glowing stars popping up around them, joyful expression.

scenes.text: Wrap it around, hug, hug, hug!
scenes.image_prompt: 3D render, vertical 9:16, Chintu and Mithu snuggled together under the glowing magical blanket, very cozy and warm, soft moonbeams illuminating their faces.

scenes.text: चाँद मामा आए, झूम झूम झूम!
scenes.image_prompt: 3D render, vertical 9:16, Chintu and Mithu floating slightly in the air under the blanket, the blanket turning into a soft night sky pattern, whimsical animation.
3D render, vertical 9:16, Chintu closing his big sparkly eyes in delight, Mithu tucking his head under his wing, the blanket glowing with gentle golden light.
3D render, vertical 9:16, Chintu and Mithu laughing happily in their sleep under the blanket, moonlight reflections on their faces, ultra cute.

scenes.text: Ruko! Magic blanket phir se dekho...
scenes.image_prompt: 3D render, vertical 9:16, the blanket starts folding itself into a neat square shape again, inviting the viewer to touch it, glowing mystery aesthetic.
